Episode 202. The Crisis of Drekhon (2)
Chiing-!

As soon as the dimensional gate of the otherworldly snowfield closed, a golden divine power spread instantly across the battlefield. It was the divine power unleashed by Bale, a fragment of the Sun God.

The Redname tribe was taken aback as they confronted the Sun God's divine power for the first time in a while. Even those named after the Sun God, the Kinzelo, had never shown such a power, and Bale had dyed the entire sky gold.
Of course, there were entities that used the power of the Sun God even when they were sealed. They, too, developed technology through the knowledge of the Sun God.

However, the Redname tribe called entities with especially strong solar energy like Bale, 'Primordial Stones', and it was the first time they saw such an incredible Primordial Stone. They were also amazed by the fact that such a Primordial Stone was under Jin's command.
[Ah! It's annoying. I was playing well with Gilly, but I was dragged here because of you guys!]
Though she spoke childishly, Bale's divine power was quickly causing cracks in the fleet's shield.

In the meantime, the leaders of each group were getting heated about the betting, preparing their clan's secret and decisive weapons. Dante was gripping his sword, thinking of his subordinate and the dragons who died earlier.
He had hastily recovered using a healing potion, so his martial arts were not in full swing. However, with comrades around, the revenge would not fail.
"Phew, I think I'll survive now. Thank you."
Hedo thanked the healers who were treating him.
[The Holy King seemed very busy, so I couldn't bring him. If you think you can fight again after receiving treatment, join the battle. I don't know if there will be a share left for you.]
"Yes, Lady Amerith."
[And Sandra was very worried about you. She looked like she was about to cry.]
Hedo's eyes widened.
"…Really? Miss Sandra was worried about me?"
[Yes. Why are you so surprised? Your old enemies are waiting. Go ahead.]
Hedo had never imagined seeing Sandra truly worry about him in all the time he served her.
He never wished for it, nor did he want to create such a situation. But now, imagining Sandra on the verge of tears, he felt something pounding in his chest.
Syris, following Amerith, glanced at Hedo.
"…You might need this, Chief of Staff."
Then he took out a handkerchief from his pocket and handed it to Hedo.
"I don't know how to cry, Lord Sagong. But I'll gratefully accept your sentiment."
"You should wipe your moistened eyes before saying such things. Well then."
As Syris left, Tasha laughed and looked at Hedo. Seeing him, she was reminded of her father, who was stubborn yet awkward in some ways, and she found it endearing.
"I'll protect you while you're being treated, Hedo."
"Ahem, thank you."
"I don't know how to cry. Tch!"
"Lady Tasha, don't do that......"
A feast of diverse final arts and abilities unfolded due to the advancement of Tasha, Hedo, and the healers and their colleagues.
When Ballas and Alpen attacked aggressively, the others supported them. The combination of solar power, Manbing, the swords of Runcandel and Hairan, and the power of Ameris formed a harmony.
The red fleet's barrage, which seemed to obliterate Kwashel Plains, was rapidly shrinking in front of them.
It was a barrage that Hedo had been holding off by himself till now. But since a large number of superhumans had participated in the battle, it was natural that the fleet's might was diminishing.

Above all, due to Dreke's descent to the ground, the flagship Baryon couldn't receive power from his reactor core. The fleet's firepower doubled only when the flagship, running at maximum output, held the center.
While it wasn't impossible to supply power from the ground, Dreke didn't have any room to do that right now.
'Why in the world isn't my ability manifesting......!'
Even the blood flowing from the scratch wound caused by Jin's spear wasn't being absorbed.
Since becoming the Grand Combatant and gaining the power of bloodsucking from the castle, Dreke had never experienced this kind of situation.

There was only one time when he was able to absorb blood, even when fighting other Grand Combatants and the Blue Dragon clan. Despite the disparity in strength causing his ability to be less effective, he still had to run away.
"You seem to be curious as to why your ability doesn't work, but shouldn't you worry about other issues right now? Like, for instance, a way to maintain as much dignity as possible, even in death."
Splat!
A droplet of blood splashed from Dreke's cheek. If he reacted a bit slower, his head would have been split in half.
'I shouldn't have given him a distance at the start. As a result, the blood I took from Hedo was consumed even faster.'

Eventually, Dreke gave up on bloodsucking and concentrated on offense and defense. Once he regained his composure, his spear moved more sharply and flexibly. However, even in terms of weapon skills, Jin was several steps ahead.
The source of Dreke's ability to instill fear into his enemies as a Red Warrior Grand Combatant was not his spear, but his unique ability, bloodsucking.
His spear technique was average among superhumans. Moreover, he was in a state where he couldn't even receive artillery support, like when he was fighting Hedo.
And his opponent was Jin, who was at the pinnacle of those superhumans, there was no chance of victory.
Therefore, the moment he decided to prepare for a return spell or a large-scale spatial leap.
Suddenly, he saw a pure white sphere forming in Jin's hand. It was the Flash Cannon. After reaching the peak, Jin was using this magic after a long time.
Whooosh-!
Drek instinctively averted his eyes from the flash bomb and stretched out his spear. It was indeed a superhuman response, but from the start, Jin didn't burst the flash bomb to target his eyes.
He intended to destroy the 'bracelet' while Drek flinched to avoid the flash bomb. It was enough to do in a split second.
Crack! The golden bracelet on his right arm broke and fell to the ground. There was one pair left on his left arm, but it was only a matter of time before it was broken as well.
Once that happens, dimensional movement becomes impossible. Even now, it was impossible for the entire forces to return intact. Drek showed a noticeable movement to protect the remaining bracelet.
"Drek, you pushed Hedo because of your bloodsucking and fleet support. If there's any substance left in your animal form, bring it out quickly. Whatever you do, the outcome won't change."
One by one, the airships were crashing from the sky. It was impossible to avoid a hard time when there was only Hedo and Dante, but now the situation has completely changed.
Drek was now in a defensive stance for survival, not with any intent. Jin continued to pressure him so that he could not rest for a moment.

All blows had flat food suppression applied, and the divine skills were mixed between the blows and stabs. If he avoided a sword coming into his eyes, the 9-sword extermination wing in the form of divine skills suddenly hit his body from the side. If he blocked a horizontal slash with a spear, a 3-sword execution awl struck down his chest.
Every time he flinched, the flying blade always aimed at the vital points. If he made a mistake for a moment, it was the end.
'Rather, he tied his feet with big skills and cut off my breath with ordinary attacks.'
With a rough attack that seemed not to care about energy management, Drek was getting tired of Jin.
Beware of Jin Runcandel, he should be treated like the Blue Plutonian race gods.
He sincerely understood why Shimat emphasized so much. He did not seem to tire at all while launching these terrible maneuvers.
'Even Jin Runcandel hasn't taken out the great king's sword yet. The swords used so far are definitely different from what Patlock's brethren said.'
While being pushed back, Drek continued to be wary of the great king's sword. He is saving his strength to escape when the Great King's sword begins.
Unfortunately, Jin knew this well.
'Surely you must have heard about the Great King's sword from Rakiman. But the pain you will experience is different.'
Suddenly, Jin planted Sigmund in the ground. Unbeknownst to anyone, pillars made of divine skills were placed around Jin and Drek.

The pillars were simultaneously thrust into the ground, and a thunderous area was formed around them. Drek mistakenly thought it was the Great King's sword for a moment, but in reality, what Jin unfolded was the 4-sword erosion of divine skills.
In the blink of an eye, hundreds of thunder strikes followed in the thunderous area. Drek managed to withstand the erosion by detonating the red thunder he had been accumulating.
'What the hell is that...!'
But he didn't expect the phoenix summoned hiding in the erosion's thunder.
Kaaaaaaaak-!
Tess was roaring, spewing out a fierce flame. Overpressure, a power that only Tess could handle, crushed Drek heavily.

"It's been a long time since I used this combination during my days as a prospective jockey for Vanessa Gyeong's test. I've become incomparably stronger since then, but somehow, I think Vanessa Gyeong could still knock all of this out even now."
It was tough for Drekk. His movement had noticeably slowed, and he was barely holding back the incoming surge of energy and spells.
And Jin left Sigmund stuck in the ground as he drew Bradamante.
Faint and hazy, yet a never-dying, magnificent flame was wrapping around the pure white blade. Runcandel Great Sword, Eternal Flame.

Since the enemy inflicted pain on his comrades with rapid blood loss, he had to repay it with the pain of burning. Seeing Jin rushing through the electrical storm, Drekk tried to protect his core by summoning an enemy's power.
Zap!

The pressure alone was oppressive enough, but the eternal flame that was carving wounds possessed a more terrifying aspect. A flame that couldn't be pushed away even by an enemy's power, it had a resemblance to the vampiric power Drekk had always enjoyed.
It was brutally one-sided. The remaining bracelets had already burst under the pressure and electric storm, and his fleet was reduced to 70%.
The only option left for Drekk was to somehow cast a return spell.
To do that, he had to first break away from Jin and use the remaining comrades as catalysts, so Drekk clenched his core as if to rip it out.
[Roaaar!]
It was the unique battle transformation of the king of battles.
"Is it a castle transformation? How stupidly large."

After the transformation, Drekk looked like a huge red lion. The roar made the world vibrate, but to Jin's eyes, it only felt like the body had grown larger, perfect for burning with the eternal flame.
Of course, it wasn't that Drekk's abilities and power had not changed. The most conspicuous change was that his vampiric power had greatly increased.

Blood was being drawn from the enemy's fleet and the comrades who were pushing away the fleet to fight, all converging towards Drekk. He was even unhesitatingly absorbing the blood of his fellow enemies.
"This is the power that Heddo Gyeong mentioned! Everyone should keep their distance."

Upon Dante's shout, Ameris, Syris, and Bale nodded. They all felt a strange sensation of blood draining from their bodies. Fortunately, it seemed the vampirism didn't reach to where Heddo and Tasha were. Of course, even the enhanced vampirism from the castle transformation was useless against Jin.
But not only Heddo and Tasha who were far away, for some reason, no blood was being drawn from Ballas and Alpen.
[Vampirism? I'm fine and so is the 20th, hmm!]
[......57th, it seems we fundamentally lack blood because we are undead.]

[Ha ha! That's it! Then, we should end the bet here and join the side of the wine to finish off that giant mosquito as soon as possible. Our comrades might get tired. Grandson! Can the 20th and I go over there!]
Jin smiled and nodded. Although he could kill them alone, he had to save even a single drop of his comrades' precious blood.
"If you had just stayed put, you would have died just by dealing with my sword, but now you've got to deal with the swords of my ancestors, Drekk."
Drekk was, inevitably, swallowed up by despair.
